This page is for visitors and English-speaking residents of Normandy. The rest of the website is in French.

## Emergencies

- **Medical emergency:** call **15** (SAMU) or **112**.
- **Poisoning:** call the Angers poison centre, which covers Normandy, on **02 41 48 21 21**, 24 hours a day.

## Reporting a side effect

Anyone can report a suspected side effect of a medicine in France, including patients and relatives. Reports are made online on the French portal [signalement.social-sante.gouv.fr](https://signalement.social-sante.gouv.fr) (in French). A pharmacist or doctor can help you.

Your report goes to the regional pharmacovigilance centre: Caen for Calvados, Manche and Orne; Rouen for Eure and Seine-Maritime. It is recorded without your name in the national database.

## Questions about your medicines

Ask a pharmacist first: pharmacies are open in every town, and an on-duty pharmacy is available at night and on Sundays. Do not stop or change a treatment without talking to a doctor or a pharmacist.
